fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) stock rose 6.3% on November 9, with recent earnings showing revenue up 379% YoY to $5.42 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Stock declined last week due to concerns over datacenter construction regulations, but investors are confident capital expenditure will continue.
fields.summary_ko.2: Of 41 datacenter-related bills voted on last week, 40 were decided unfavorably for the industry, presenting risk that political opposition materializes.
